name: Api Nodanna Live
overview: Podi Malli and Chooti Malli amuse the audience with their humour. Api Nodanna Live (අපි නොදන්න ලයිව්) was a highly popular Sri Lankan comedy sketch television show broadcast by Sirasa TV. It is widely credited with introducing a more intellectual and subtle style of comedy to Sri Lankan television, moving away from traditional slapstick.
